description: [PAID $0.008 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Render a public web page in a real headless Chrome (JavaScript executed, waits for network idle) and return a screenshot: viewport (default 1280x800) or full page (up to 8000 px tall), PNG or JPEG, optional dark mode and extra wait. JSON with image_base64 + finalUrl/status/title, or raw image bytes with format=png|jpeg. Typically 2-6 s (up to ~25 s when busy). Use it for visual QA, link previews, archiving, checking what a page really shows, or feeding a vision model. Adult/malware domains (Cloudflare family DNS) and private addresses are refused. All params optional: with none it captures https://example.com. Errors are never charged.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page, capped at 8000 px tall (default false).

url.description: Public http(s) URL to capture (hostname, not IP). Optional: defaults to https://example.com.

waitMs.description: Extra wait after load before capturing, ms (default 0).

name: screenshot_url
title: Screenshot a URL (headless Chrome)
